articles.title: I covered myself in sleep trackers to find the very best
articles.summary: Get a better night’s sleep with monitoring and guidance from smartwatches, smart rings, smart bands and sleep earbuds. The best sleep masks and best Bluetooth sleep masks. Getting quality sleep is just as crucial as getting enough sleep. And how you feel in the morning only tells part of the story.
body: Armed with this information, you can learn how your lifestyle affects your sleep. Maybe your after dinner cappuccino triggers a night of tossing and turning, or you’re more restful after evening workouts. As the wise GI Joe once said, knowing is half the battle. And the more you know about your sleep, the better chance you have of improving it.

As a consumer technology journalist for more than two decades, I began wearing fitness trackers in the early 2010s and have since reviewed hundreds of products in the sleep and fitness space. After spending more than 15 years tracking my sleep nightly, I have a deep understanding of how wearables work, which brands and products are reliable and how to best interpret app data.

I wore up to five wearables at a time (two wrist devices, two rings, and earbuds) for at least seven nights each. Every morning, I plotted sleep data into a spreadsheet, including duration, sleep stages (light, REM, deep, awake), along with average sleep heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) when available.

articles.title: An age gap isn’t always a problem, partner abuse is | Letters
articles.summary: Readers respond to articles on relationships and the age of consent. Regarding Polly Hudson’s article ( At 17, I dated a 36-year-old. That decision looks very different to me now, 15 November ), I met and lived with a 35-year-old man when I was 17.
body: I learned that he had done it all before, pursuing schoolgirls. I tried to break free multiple times, only to find that he had phoned my new partner, or read my diary so he could block my plans. This is about having control, it is not just a sexual preference.

The men doing this are rarely satisfied, and criticism can escalate to coercive, emotionally abusive levels. In some cases (though not in mine) girls are pimped out, shared with the man’s friends, imprisoned against their will.

Polly Hudson should not be angry with her younger self. Would she be angry with another young girl who found herself in similar circumstances? Unlikely. There is something else that has stopped us speaking out: fear. Fear of physical or verbal retaliation by the perpetrator; of the judgment of those around us; of a legal system that fails to punish abusers and shames victims with hackneyed tropes that have long been disproven; of public and private organisations that continue to bury abuse allegations and enable perpetrators who bring in cash, clicks, viewers or shareholders.

articles.title: The link between nurturing and masculinity | Letter
articles.summary: Clincal psychotherapist Gareth Strangemore-Jones responds to an article on persistent assumptions about masculinity. Sarah Blaffer Hrdy’s research offers an important challenge to one of our most persistent assumptions about masculinity: that nurturing is somehow contrary to male nature ( Would…
body: We often imagine psychological development as a process in which attitudes must change before behaviour follows. Yet caregiving may work in both directions. Repeated experiences of responding to another person’s vulnerability can engage and potentially strengthen the biological and psychological systems involved in emotional responsiveness, attachment and cooperation.

But we should be cautious about extending this into the claim that more nurturing fathers would necessarily produce a more peaceful world. Human beings are capable of extraordinary tenderness towards their own children while remaining hostile towards those outside their immediate circle. Empathy can be selective, and the causes of collective violence extend far beyond individual temperament.
Perhaps the more important question is whether the emotional capacities developed through caregiving can be extended towards strangers, communities and people with whom we disagree.

articles.title: When the Days of Being Wild Come to an End
articles.summary: I used to romanticize being a bit of a disaster. Now, I have become a man who just...likes things to be nice.
body: This week, after reading up about the major differences between sea salt and rock salt, I found myself looking at a shot of my mates in an east London restaurant’s smoking area. My friends looked happy—mildly drunk, joyous, their night still full of possibility—and I felt… hmmm… hard to say what I felt. Not jealous, not one bit, but also not relieved that I was home and dry. Maybe the word is content? Happy enough for them without longing for a sip from the same goblet.

I rather romanticized being a bit of a disaster. I think we all did back then. Blame Pete Doherty. There was something appealing about running on…erm… adrenaline, partying at capacity, being slightly behind on everything else. I mistook a lack of self-preservation for spontaneity and great swathes of disorganization for having a social life. I didn’t want to become one of those people who had everything Filofaxed; those people had missed the point of being alive.
points: I used to romanticize being a bit of a disaster.

articles.title: When It Comes to Bags, Harry Styles Is Pro-Schlepping
articles.summary: Harry Styles loves a big, honking bag—and bonus points if it’s a luxurious Chanel flap. What could he be carrying around in that capacious flap bag?
body: After completing his Together, Together residency at New York’s Madison Square Garden last month, Harry Styles deserved a little R&R. Where did the singer choose to spend that little smidgen of time off before he traveled to Australia for his next leg? Rome, Italy, of course.

Naturally, Styles’s latest outing served up a perfectly casual-cool outfit. A sleek khaki trench coat? Check! Classic straight-leg jeans and brown leather loafers? Check-check. The whole outfit felt modern, yet discrete—except for that big, honking bag. The large black leather Chanel maxi flap bag, with silver hardware, immediately caught our eye.

Designed by Mathieu Blazy, the XXL Chanel flap has been one of the designer’s biggest hits while helming the French label. Everyone is going crazy for the huge, unstructured bags, which retail for over $13,000. Fellow stars like A$AP Rocky and Kendall Jenner have been carting them around their shoulder, too. Others, like Rosalía, find their capacious carry-alls elsewhere.

articles.title: Bon Appétit Pick: HelloFresh Garlicky Shrimp Couscous Bowl
articles.summary: A cheffy detail helps pack a simple dish with flavor.
body: Most nights I try to hit up an exercise class after work, which means when I finally get home in the evening I'm tired, hungry, and craving something full of nutrients. With 26 grams of protein and just 25 minutes of prep-and-cook time, HelloFresh's Garlicky Shrimp Couscous Bowl is a great solution for dinner.

This flavorful bowl reminds me of Dig Inn's glory days—only I can enjoy it without elbowing my way through midtown lunchtime mobs. Roasted broccoli and shrimp sautéed with lemon and plenty of garlic are spooned on top of large couscous pearls. Chili flakes add an extra kick.

You'll need to grab olive oil, butter, salt, and pepper from your own pantry; everything else is included in your delivery. The shrimp arrives fully cleaned and deveined, thank god. I love that a small pouch of veggie stock is included for cooking your couscous, a detail that many meal kits overlook.
points: A cheffy detail helps pack a simple dish with flavor.

articles.title: Gabbriette Bechtel and Matty Healy Are Expecting Their First Baby
articles.summary: First romantically linked in September 2023, Gabbriette and Matty married in July of this year at a Hollywood Hills estate.
body: Gabbriette Bechtel and Matty Healy have a new gig: parents! The 1975 frontman and model, musician, and Charli XCX muse are expecting their first child together, as per People ’s report.

The couple were photographed on a grocery run at Bristol Farms in West Hollywood, with Bechtel showing a visible baby bump. Healy carried several shopping bags, dressed in a navy jacket, gray T-shirt, distressed jeans, and boots, while Bechtel wore a black midi dress with a plunging neckline and simple black ballet flats.

Bechtel and Healy were first romantically linked in September 2023, when they were photographed kissing in New York City. In June 2024, Bechtel confirmed their engagement on Instagram with a photograph of her custom black diamond ring, featuring an elongated cushion-cut stone, halo setting, and triple-split shank. Her announcement, made following Charli XCX’s Brat show in Brooklyn, was fittingly irreverent: “MARRYING THE 1975 IS VERY BRAT.”

articles.title: Flashback to 1965: Truman Capote and the Seaside Studio He Designed for Work
articles.summary: Some of Truman Capote’s soon-to-be-auctioned possessions were photographed by Vogue in the author’s home in Sagaponack, Long Island.
body: “Truman Capote and the Country Studio He Designed for Work,” photographed by Horst P. Horst originally appeared in the November 1965 issue of Vogue.

Bright, shining colors are the mark of Truman Capote’s studio with its sophisticated farmhouse qualities. It fits Capote: witty, complicatedly simple, with extravagant gestures. After he bought the house, he had it stripped down to a shell, then converted it to his needs: a lot of color, the look of raw woods, comfort, a good kitchen, and no guest rooms. (When a friend came for lunch, he found Capote marinating cucumbers.) It is so solitary—the beach stretches four miles on either side of the house—that on the Fourth of July he saw only three people walking along.
